highlights: **Mobile:** Android and iPad layouts adapt better to window width: sidebars float over medium-width pages, inspectors become sheets on narrower screens, and Android pane transitions keep the screen filled.
**Recovery and performance:** Runs that never started can retry after recovery. Recovery, settlement, and agent startup avoid unnecessary database reads, reducing work in larger environments.
**Claude:** The model picker can include models reported by your installed Claude Code, alongside the bundled catalog and custom models.

**Files and tools:** MCP and OpenCode images display more reliably. Terminal file links use filesystem checks, missing-file caches stay thread-local, and diffs load selected-file metadata before patches.
**Polish:** Usage tables, thread status rows, and dialog titles are easier to read. This release tracks upstream 0.1.7 and retains our sidebar controls.
**Fork releases:** Update notes now use a reviewed summary of what changed, with the generated commit references kept below for traceability. Installation and server activation remain separate steps.
